# Andy Plester Golf

Andy Plester is a PGA Professional and Leicestershire County Coach with over 22 years of coaching experience. He is based at Ullesthorpe Court Golf Club in Leicestershire, is the author of The Up & Down Game, and coaches golfers online worldwide through Skillest.

## Start here

- Free golf assessment: https://skillest.com/@andyplester#evaluation — send swing videos for personal feedback from Andy and a clear first priority.
- Performance Coaching: $89 USD per month for two online lessons each month, personal video analysis and a personalised practice plan.
- Skillest: https://skillest.com/@andyplester

## Main website pages

- Home and free golf assessment: https://andyplestergolf.com/
- Online coaching: https://andyplestergolf.com/coaching.html
- About Andy: https://andyplestergolf.com/about.html
- The Up & Down Game book: https://andyplestergolf.com/book.html

## Coaching approach

Andy provides complete personalised golf coaching, with particular expertise in short game and scoring. The Up & Down System uses the CLEAR Process and Four Stages to give golfers a structured route from assessment to focused practice and lasting improvement.
